pilot_limitations: the source-procedure corpus and artifact catalog are controlled pilot fixtures shipped with the image, not a live source registry; a production runtime would read them from Cloud Storage and Firestore
a workflow recovered from durable storage can be read but not resumed in a new instance; resuming a persisted run is T097

boundary: Cloud Run IAM is the authentication boundary. /health and /ready sit behind the same policy as every other route; the service is private.
